EXTRAORDINARYThe Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE HAMBANTHOTA PRADESHIYASABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE(CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Hambanthota Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation;

AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the People’s Liberation Front, the recognized political party to which HewaWathudurage Wimalathissa the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66 A (1) of the aforesaid ordinance,to decide upon returned member if People’s Liberation Front who belongs to such party and is not disqualified underSection 9 of the local authorities Elections Ordinance and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period of thirty(30) days ;
AND WHEREAS the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized Political Party, has communicated his decision tonominate Munasinghe Arachchige Chandradasa Munasinghe to fill such vacancy ;

NOW THEREFORE I, Ravindra Subhashana Wedage, Returning Officer of the Hambanthota Pradeshiya Sabha,acting in terms of Section 66A(1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that MunasingheArachchige Chandradasa Munasinghe was Selected as the member of the Hambanthota Pradeshiya Sabha.
RAVINDRA SUBHASHANA WEDAGE,Returning Officer,Hambanthota Pradeshiya Sabha.
